P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait appears anywhere on the page; the layout is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: The client (Conesso GmbH) is referenced by name only in a text block; there is no portrait image of any size.

P07.rationale: A pull-quote with attribution serves as a minimal testimonial, but there is no logo wall, rating card, or review grid.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears before the testimonial block, but no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative type elements are present.

P11.rationale: Three before/after metric pairs (30→2 min, 60→5 min, 3 workflows eliminated) are listed as text callouts, but no actual chart or visual data representation is used.

P12.rationale: The layout is clean and structured but leaves a large empty region in the lower third of the page, preventing a truly dense, magazine-quality fill.

P13.rationale: The dark sidebar panel provides some tonal contrast and atmosphere, but the main body is a flat white with no texture or background treatment.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable; scored 0 as absent.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: There are no stock images at all, which avoids generic imagery, though the absence of any visuals also means no specificity is conveyed.

N08.rationale: A substantial empty white region occupies roughly the bottom quarter of the page with no content, constituting noticeable dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo; all text sits on clean white or the dark sidebar panel with no readability issues.
